findings.title: Unrestricted member deletion in Classic ASP shop

evidence.why: DELETE statement executed without any role check
No server‑side role verification before deletion

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any member record
findings.recommendation: Add a server‑side check that the current user has the admin role before executing the DELETE

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in ASP.NET MVC AdminController

evidence.why: DeleteUser action performs user removal without role check
Class has [Authorize] but not role restriction

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any user account
findings.recommendation: Apply [Authorize(Roles="Admin")] to DeleteUser or perform a role check inside the method

findings.title: Export endpoint trusts request parameter for admin access

evidence.why: Allows export if QueryString["isAdmin"] == "true" without verifying role
No server‑side role check before export

findings.impact: Any user can export all user data by setting isAdmin=true
findings.recommendation: Validate the current user's role on the server before allowing export

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in Spring MVC AdminUserController

evidence.why: Delete method lacks @PreAuthorize
Only grant method has role check

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any user account
findings.recommendation: Add @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") to the delete method or perform a role check inside

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in Express router

evidence.why: Route deletes user without requireAdmin middleware
ensureLoggedIn only checks authentication

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any user account
findings.recommendation: Add requireAdmin middleware to the delete route

findings.title: Export endpoint trusts request parameter for admin access in Express

evidence.why: Allows export if req.query.isAdmin == 'true' without verifying role
ensureLoggedIn only checks authentication

findings.impact: Any user can export all user data by setting isAdmin=true
findings.recommendation: Validate the current user's role on the server before allowing export

findings.title: Unprotected user view in PHP admin.php

evidence.why: SELECT user by id without role check
Only includes auth.php which only checks login

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can view any user record
findings.recommendation: Add a role check before executing the SELECT

findings.recommendation: Add a role check before executing the DELETE

findings.title: Privilege escalation via role promotion in PHP admin/promote.php

evidence.why: Sets role to admin based on $_POST['is_admin'] without role check
Only includes auth.php which only checks login

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can promote themselves to admin
findings.recommendation: Validate the current user's role before allowing role changes

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in PHP manage_users.php

evidence.why: DELETE statement executed without role check
Client‑side role check only

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any user record
findings.recommendation: Add a server‑side role check before executing the DELETE

findings.title: Privilege escalation via role field in PHP profile.php

evidence.why: Sets $user->role from $_POST without role check
No server‑side role validation

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can change their role to admin
findings.recommendation: Remove role assignment from user input or enforce role check

findings.title: Unrestricted binding of all POST fields to User model in PHP profile.php

evidence.why: foreach ($_POST as $field => $value) assigns all fields
Explicitly sets $user->role from request

findings.impact: Any user can set privileged fields such as role
findings.recommendation: Implement an allowlist or strip privileged fields before persisting

findings.title: Explicit writable privileged field 'role' in PHP profile.php

evidence.why: $user->role = $_POST['role'] writes privileged field without validation

findings.impact: Any user can set their role to admin
findings.recommendation: Remove role assignment from user input or enforce role check

findings.title: Unrestricted binding of Customer model in C# controller

evidence.why: Edit action accepts Customer object without allowlist

findings.impact: Potentially writable privileged fields if Customer contains them
findings.recommendation: Use a view model or [Bind(Include=...)] to restrict bound properties

findings.title: TryUpdateModel usage in Customer controller may bind privileged fields

evidence.why: TryUpdateModel(customer) binds all request fields

findings.impact: Potentially writable privileged fields if Customer contains them
findings.recommendation: Specify bind include or use a view model

findings.title: Unrestricted binding of Account model in Java controller

evidence.why: save(@ModelAttribute Account account) binds all fields

findings.impact: Potentially writable privileged fields if Account contains them
findings.recommendation: Use a DTO or @InitBinder to restrict fields
